what: float64 exact divergence of deep tanh MLP vector fields s(x) = W_L tanh(W_n ... tanh(W_1 x + b_1) ...) + b_L, s: R^D -> R^D, at B points: forward = objective values; vg = objective and its gradient w.r.t. every weight and bias. Candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.projected_divergence.projected_deep_divergence: div s = tr(S_n W_n ... W_2 S_1 C) with C = W_1 W_L (cyclic trace); closed forms for n = 1 (diag(C) . s_1) and n = 2 (s_2^T (W_2 o C^T) s_1), H_n projected columns for n >= 3, and the D input columns when (n - 2) H_n >= (n - 1) D. The cell with D < H is a control where the candidate carries the D input columns (the same work as the full-input recursion); autodiff Jacobians are run where B D^2 <= 5e9
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method's forward and vg programs on a reduced instance (width 4, B = 2, D_q = min(D, 12) > 4 so the projection is active, seed + 1) vs a 50-digit oracle (the full D x D Jacobian as a product of matrices and its trace, no projection; objective derivatives along two fixed random parameter directions by central differences in 50 digits): values and objective 1e-9 / 2e-10, directional derivatives 1e-8 / 2e-9 (scaled); full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.full_input_recursion: forward recursion of the hidden Jacobians seeded with the D columns of W_1, reading row d of W_L for input d: the strongest full-input exact program, no D x D Jacobian
tiers.projected_generic: the same cyclic-trace projection through jax.jvp: H_n JVPs of z_1 -> a_n along the columns of C = W_1 W_L per point; isolates the closed-form contraction from the projection
tiers.autodiff_jacobian: trace of jax.jacfwd or jax.jacrev of s per point, vmapped; B D^2 <= 5e9

roles.held_out: cells, operators and seed not used for any tuning

full_size_accuracy.what: max over repetitions of per-field relative deviations (norms and sampled entries scaled by the largest sampled reference magnitude) between methods at full size; floor = two controls

cold_cost.what: per cell, medians over repetitions: cold = lowering + compilation ms (excluded from the speed ratios), steady = steady-state median ms, for the candidate and the steady-state-fastest member of every tier; break_even_calls = extra cold ms / steady saving per call (only when the candidate compiles slower and runs faster)
